title: An interesting climate
description: A bilingual lesson about England's climate, regional weather, seasons, and conversation. 关于英国气候、各地天气、季节和谈话的双语课程。
answer_note: The textbook listening answer is suggested; no official textbook answer key was supplied. Workbook answers were checked against the Lesson 53 key across key-048-053.jpg and key-053-058.jpg. The final workbook dialogue response is personal and suggested. Grammar answers were checked against the Lesson 53 key on PDF pages 485–486. Printed worked examples are not editable.

lesson.title: Before reading
lesson.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。在英国最受欢迎的话题是什么？

questions.prompt: What is the favourite subject of conversation in England?
questions.answer: The weather is the favourite subject of conversation in England.

lines.speaker: HANS
lines.text: What’s the climate like in your country?
lines.translation: 你们国家的气候怎么样？

lines.speaker: JIM
lines.text: It’s mild, but it’s not always pleasant.
lines.translation: 气候温和，但也不总是宜人的。

lines.speaker: JIM
lines.text: The weather’s often cold in the North and windy in the East.
lines.translation: 北部的天气常常寒冷，东部则常常刮风。

lines.speaker: JIM
lines.text: It’s often wet in the West and sometimes warm in the South.
lines.translation: 西部常下雨，南部有时则很暖和。

lines.speaker: HANS
lines.text: Which seasons do you like best?

lines.speaker: JIM
lines.text: The days are long and the nights are short.

lines.speaker: JIM
lines.text: The sun rises early and sets late.

lines.speaker: JIM
lines.text: I don’t like autumn and winter.

lines.speaker: JIM
lines.text: The days are short and the nights are long.

lines.speaker: JIM
lines.text: The sun rises late and sets early.

lines.speaker: JIM
lines.text: Our climate is not very good, but it’s certainly interesting.
lines.translation: 我们国家的气候并不很好，但确实很有意思。

lines.speaker: JIM
lines.text: It’s our favourite subject of conversation.
lines.translation: 天气是我们最喜欢谈论的话题。

items.title: in the North = in the north of England
items.text:
in the North = in the north of England
North 的第一个字母大写，是因为它单独使用，特指英国的北部。

lesson.text:
参考译文

汉斯：你是哪国人？
吉姆：我是英国人。
汉斯：你们国家的气候怎么样？
吉姆：气候温和，但也不总是宜人的。

吉姆：北部的天气常常寒冷，东部则常常刮风。
西部常下雨，南部有时则很暖和。

汉斯：你最喜欢哪些季节？
吉姆：我最喜欢春季和夏季。因为此时白天长而夜晚短，太阳升得早而落得晚。

吉姆：我不喜欢秋季和冬季。因为此时白天短而夜晚长，太阳升得迟而落得早。
虽然我们国家的气候并不很好，但确实很有意思。天气是我们最喜欢谈论的话题。

practice.title: A Dialogue
practice.instruction: Read this dialogue. Fill in the missing words. Answer the last question for yourself.
practice.translation: 读对话，填空。根据你自己的情况来回答最后一个问题。
practice.context: The dialogue concerns seasons, the length of days and nights, and the time the sun rises and sets.

questions.prompt: Hans: ______ season do you like ______, Jim?
Jim: I ______ summer. The days ______ long and the ______ are short. The sun ______ early and it ______ late.
Jim: I ______ like autumn. It’s cold and ______.
Hans: Which ______ do you like ______? Why?

questions.answer: I like spring best because the days are long and the nights are short.

practice.title: B Vocabulary
practice.instruction: Match the words on the left with words on the right, and write the pairs here. Now fill in the blanks in these sentences with appropriate words.
practice.translation: 从两框中找出反义词，并抄在横线上。用恰当的词填空。
practice.context: Source word boxes: left box: wet, cold, long, north, late, east. Right box: short, hot, dry, early, south, west. The source gives the worked example “wet – dry”.

questions.prompt: wet – dry
north – ______
The days in winter are ______. They aren’t long.
The weather in that country is sometimes ______. It isn’t always hot.
It’s ______ here in autumn. It isn’t often dry.
The sun rises in the ______ and it sets in the west.
China, Japan, Thailand and Korea are in the East. They aren’t in the ______.
It’s cold in the north of the country, but it’s mild in the ______.

practice.title: C Numbers
practice.translation: 用阿拉伯数字表示以下序数词。
practice.context: The printed rows pair each ordinal word with a blank for its numeral form.

twenty-first

grammar.title: I. Add the frequency adverbs
grammar.instruction: Add the frequency adverbs given to the sentences and rewrite them.
grammar.translation: 用所给频率副词改写下列句子。

questions.prompt: Mrs. Smith goes to the shops. (every day)
questions.answer: Mrs. Smith goes to the shops every day.

questions.prompt: John cleans his teeth. (every day)
questions.answer: John cleans his teeth every day.

questions.prompt: My son rides a bike to school, but he goes by bus. (often/sometimes)
questions.answer: My son often rides a bike to school, but he sometimes goes by bus.

questions.prompt: It’s mild in the North. (sometimes)
questions.answer: It’s sometimes mild in the North.

questions.prompt: You come to class very early. (always)
questions.answer: You always come to class very early.

questions.prompt: The students ask interesting questions. (often)
questions.answer: The students often ask interesting questions.

questions.prompt: Mrs. Bird cooks meals, and her husband does, too. (often/sometimes)
questions.answer: Mrs. Bird often cooks meals, and her husband sometimes does, too.

questions.prompt: It rains in spring, but it rains in autumn, too. (sometimes/often)
questions.answer: It sometimes rains in spring, but it often rains in autumn, too.

questions.prompt: The baby next door cries. (every day)
questions.answer: The baby next door cries every day.

questions.prompt: She likes books, and she reads at home. (always/often)
questions.answer: She always likes books, and she often reads at home.

grammar.title: II. Turn the statements into negatives
grammar.instruction: Turn the statements into negatives according to the example.
grammar.translation: 仿照例句将下列肯定句改为否定句。
grammar.source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=164
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=485
grammar.context: Printed example: 1. My children often eat lamb. My children don’t often eat lamb.

questions.prompt: My children often eat lamb.
questions.answer: My children don’t often eat lamb.

questions.prompt: The sun shines every day in summer.
questions.answer: The sun doesn’t shine every day in summer.

questions.prompt: It’s always windy in the South.
questions.answer: It isn’t always windy in the South.

questions.prompt: He always speaks English.
It’s always pleasant here in spring.
questions.answer: It isn’t always pleasant here in spring.

questions.prompt: I often buy fresh fruit.
questions.answer: I don’t often buy fresh fruit.

questions.prompt: They work hard every day.
questions.answer: They don’t work hard every day.

questions.prompt: She often does her homework in her bedroom.
questions.answer: She doesn’t often do her homework in her bedroom.

questions.prompt: You always like tomatoes.
His father always washes the dishes.
questions.answer: His father doesn’t always wash the dishes.

questions.prompt: It’s often windy here.
It’s always wet in Qingdao.
questions.answer: It isn’t always wet in Qingdao.

grammar.instruction: Answer the questions, using the words given according to the example.
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用所给的词回答下列问题。
